headline: Jollibee eyes 30 stores in UK expansion
summary: Jollibee Foods plans to grow its UK restaurant count from 12 to 30 over three years, using franchising in cities such as Manchester and Birmingham. The plan follows its Oxford Street flagship opening.
why: Jollibee Foods Corporation is a Philippine fast-food group with a large international franchise network. Its overseas expansion shows how it grows outside its home market.
